title: Mapping effective connectivity of human amygdala with intracranial stimulation - es-TT evoked potentials (Sawada-2022-mapping-10.1038/s41467-022-32644-y)
description: Intracranial EEG evoked-potential epochs recorded during single-pulse electrical stimulation of the human amygdala (electrical stimulation tract-tracing, es-TT) in neurosurgical patients. The dataset includes 11 participants and 46 stimulation runs of epoched depth, strip and grid electrode recordings, supporting mapping of effective connectivity of amygdala subdivisions. It is a BIDS conversion of the OSF release accompanying Sawada et al., Nature Communications 2022.
methods_description: Epoched iEEG evoked potentials (typically 60 epochs per run) were recorded from depth, strip and grid electrodes during single-pulse electrical stimulation of the amygdala, with a subgaleal reference. Sampling rates were 8 kHz for most runs, 2 kHz for some and 16 kHz for others. The stimulus artefact defines the epoch time zero.
